notes: API rates, units, peak schedule and unlisted cache-write state as displayed on the pricing page accessed 2026-10-15. The V4-Pro-0813 label is retained as a page label; current routing is recorded from the separate release-announcement source.

claims.statement: As accessed 2026-10-15, DeepSeek API rates per 1M tokens are USD cache-hit input $0.006 peak/$0.003 off-peak, cache-miss input $0.30/$0.15, and output $1.20/$0.60. The page lists no separate cache-write rate; its value is unknown here, not zero. These rates describe DeepSeek API billing, not OpenCode’s separate route.
Peak pricing applies 01:00–04:00 and 06:00–10:00 UTC Monday–Friday except Chinese public holidays; other periods are off-peak at half the peak rate.
